answer_1.quote: We introduce the Focus-Centric Visual Chain paradigm to solve complex multi-image tasks through question decomposition and stepwise reasoning.

answer_2.quote: Extensive experiments across seven multi-image benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach... achieving new state-of-the-art on four out of the seven.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three annotators (Ph.D. students in Computer Science and Technology) to evaluate the correctness of 200 randomly sampled instances from VISC-150K.
answer_4.guideline: An instance was labeled as correct by an annotator only when all three criteria were satisfied: Final Answer Correctness, Sub-Question Answer Correctness, and Visual Focus Validity.
